vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2023-0071
vulnerability.description: Marvin Attack: potential key recovery through timing side channels in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption

statements.impact_statement: 3va uses the rsa crate only to sign and verify (crypto.createSign/createVerify) and, through russh, for SSH signatures. RSA private-key decryption (RsaPrivateKey::decrypt), the only code path affected by the timing side channel, is never called.
